verdict.rationale: Vendor features (large-codebase querying/editing, non-interactive scripting, JSON output, PR/rebase automation) directly support bulk operations across many items, and some users praise its 1M-context window for handling large codebases at scale. However, multiple community reports describe it getting stuck in error loops, failing at simple file operations, and being 'terrible at agentic stuff,' undermining reliable bulk automation.
